text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Happy birthday! Let's make it a wonderful 
day♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wah, thank you! Just hearing you say that 
makes me super happy.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Actually, I've been thinking for a 
while now about what I could do to give 
Palmer-san the best birthday possible.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's this? You're awfully 
motivated today... Could it be you're 
throwing a party for me or something?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the party. Today, we shall 
be... speaking entirely in gyaru slang.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Helios-chan always says being a gal is all 
about fun and high energy. So, it's 
perfect for a day like today! Right?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. ...Wait, no—heyyy, let's go! Let's 
get crazy hyped and totally pumped!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno-chan! You've gotta speak up more and 
move your body too, y'know~~~! Come on, 
and-a-one, two!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Ahaha. You're right, I'm getting hyped! 
Thanks, you two. Ayyyy, ayyyy!
